source.diagram: Al2O3-MgO phase diagram based mainly on the results of Rankin, Merwin [1], Alper et al. [2] (sub-system MgO-MgO·Al2O3) and Viechnicki et al. [3] (sub-system Al2O3-MgO·Al2O3)
source.caption: Atlas text (printed p. 44): solid-state boundaries re-investigated by Roy, Coble [4] and Ando, Momoda [5] (solubility of MgO in Al2O3), Stubican, Roy [6], Henriksen, Kingery [7] and Mori [8] (solubility of Al2O3 in MgO), Roy et al. [9], Shirasuka, Yamaguchi [10], Viertel, Seifert [11] and Panda, Raj [12] (MgO·Al2O3 phase boundary). Solubility of Al2O3 in MgO determined by Alper et al. [2] confirmed with minor changes in [6-8]. Maximum solubility of MgO in Al2O3 does not exceed 0.001 mass% [5]. Thermodynamic evaluations: Hallstedt, Hillert [16], Howald, Roy [17], Hallstedt [18], Eriksson et al. [19]. 'In the last assessment made by Hallstedt [18], a minimum on the MgO·Al2O3 liquidus curve instead of a eutectic between MgO·Al2O3 and Al2O3 has been proposed.' References: [1] G. A. Rankin, H. E. Merwin, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 38 (1916) 568/88; [2] A. M. Alper, R. N. McNally, P. H. Ribbe, R. C. Doman, J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 45 (1962) 263/8; [3] D. Viechnicki, F. Schmid, J. W. McCauley, J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 57 (1974) 47/8; [18] B. Hallstedt, Report TRITA-MAC-0399, Royal Institute of Technology, Stockholm (1989).

invariants.notes: Both NBS entries are approximate and differ from each other by 75 °C; the atlas value lies between them. Spinel at the eutectic is the Al2O3-rich solid solution (printed '6.5' mass% MgO). The atlas text reports that Hallstedt's assessment proposes a liquidus minimum instead of a eutectic here. Fig. 3.187 edge: 97.6 wt% Al2O3, no temperature (mas-edge-spinel-corundum).
Solid phases at the eutectic: spinel ss at 39 and periclase ss at 82 mass% MgO (printed labels). Fig. 3.187 edge prints 1850 °C at 45.2 wt% MgO (mas-edge-periclase-spinel).

source.read: printed labels '6.5' (Al2O3-rich limit at the corundum eutectic) and '39' (MgO-rich limit at the periclase eutectic)

solidSolutions.notes: Wide Al2O3-rich solubility at high temperature (to 93.5 wt% Al2O3), narrowing on cooling (dashed solvus). The '6.5' label is circled by hand in the scan.

source.read: printed label '82.' at the end of the eutectic line

solidSolutions.notes: Up to 18 wt% Al2O3 dissolved in MgO at the eutectic (Alper et al. [2]); solvus falls steeply on cooling.
